integrity: The infinite matrix sum and its asymptotic are proved analytically; no claim of independent certification is made.
scientific_limitations: The statement controls Schatten-two membership and a critical asymptotic for a fixed logarithmic weight; it does not determine trace-class membership, individual singular values, or the full operator norm. Possible unindexed antecedents are an originality risk.
title: Sharp Hilbert–Schmidt blow-up at the logarithmic Bergman endpoint
